name: Isle

modes.label: Native product meter; not a general-purpose 4-vCPU/8-GiB VM
modes.note: Not auto-rankable for generic VM workloads. Native price and usage limits are preserved in provider rate_cards/extras and regimes. Empty sizes intentionally prevents inventing CPU/RAM capacity or treating missing rates as zero.

evidence.quote: imports, files and installed CLI commands run inside the restricted worker with the shared workspace and no external network access

plans.name: Developer
plans.note: 100 environment-hours/month; no per-session runtime cap; priority support.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: Custom price ('tailored to your workload'); unlimited environment-hours; unlimited concurrency; custom application environments; dedicated support; SLA and uptime guarantees. Contract terms not published.

caveats: No CPU/RAM allocation or overage environment-hour price published.
Developer limit 5 concurrent and 100 included hours does not meet 50 concurrent / 8,800 hours.
Artifact checkpoint is not evidence of a full memory VM snapshot; state/export support scoped to application workflow.
Environment containment is not a documented hypervisor isolation type; leave isolation null/unknown.
Enterprise unlimited claims are contractual, not an entitlement on $29 plan.
Native billing cannot be reduced to a 4-vCPU/8-GiB price. No matching engine sizes, by design.

Included environment-hours and concurrency are enforced as account limits: the API returns HTTP 403 when the account usage/concurrency limit is reached. No overage or pay-as-you-go rate is published, so usage stops at 5 h (Free) / 100 h (Developer) per month.

Sandboxes have no external network access from the execution worker; terminal/browser/package-manager windows are blocked. File transfer is capped at 4 MiB per file; checkpoint workspace/bundle at 256 MiB; recordings at 512 MiB / 6 h.

fleet.tiers: Free 1 environment; Developer 5; Enterprise advertised unlimited via contract.
fleet.notes: Managed desktop environments, not unlimited generic VM capacity. All target fleet sizes 10/50/300/1,000 exceed Developer and need Enterprise contact.

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages

snapshot_on_demand.quote: POST /sandboxes/{id}/checkpoints, JSON {"action":"checkpoint"} or {}: local checkpoint metadata plus persisted and persistence_reason.
snapshot_on_demand.note: sandbox.checkpoint() / POST .../checkpoints lets the caller trigger a checkpoint of the current application state via API at any time, which is exactly an on-demand snapshot (scoped to the saved project workspace, not a full VM memory snapshot, but still on-demand). This resolves the card's own flagged contradiction: snapshot type is 'fs' and pause_resume is true, yet snapshot_on_demand was false. Correct value is true.

harness_api.quote: Keep model-provider credentials in your client process, outside desktop scripts and files.
harness_api.note: The agent runs client-side; Isle exposes screenshot/mouse/keyboard/file primitives plus a persistent Python execution API ('model-neutral'). Codex and GPT Astra are supported only as client-side examples/shell bridge (examples/codex/desktop.py, examples/astra/run.py), not as a harness running inside the environment driven via API. 'An Isle MCP connector is not included.'

secret_proxy.quote: Keep model-provider credentials in the client process.
secret_proxy.note: No secrets feature of any kind (no env vars, no secret store, no proxy); the environment has no external network for agent code, and model keys stay with the client-side agent.

volume_attach.quote: Transfers operate on regular files beneath /home/user/work/
volume_attach.note: Full REST reference has no volume/storage-attach endpoints; storage is the environment's own /home/user/work workspace, moved via 4 MiB-per-file upload/download.

volume_shared.note: No volumes, so no shared volumes.

image_oci.quote: ### KiCad (`kicad`) ... ### FreeCAD (`freecad`) ... `isle.sandboxes.create(environment, *, name=None, retain=True, timeout=360.0, idempotency_key=None) -> Sandbox`
image_oci.note: Only two fixed, provider-built application environments (kicad, freecad) can be created; there is no API or docs mention of starting a sandbox from a customer-supplied Docker/OCI image. 'Custom application environments' is listed only as an Enterprise contract item, not a self-serve OCI-image feature.

docker_inside.quote: imports, files and installed CLI commands run inside the restricted worker with the shared workspace and no external network access.
docker_inside.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — a locked-down desktop-application execution worker with no external network access and no documented container runtime inside it.

nested_virt.quote: Managed application environments for computer-use agents. Launch KiCad and FreeCAD with built-in guardrails, artifact checkpoints, and automatic recovery.
nested_virt.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — a managed CAD/EDA desktop-application sandbox, not a general VM; no /dev/kvm or nested virtualization is documented anywhere.

anti_bot.quote: Managed application environments for computer-use agents. Launch KiCad and FreeCAD with built-in guardrails, artifact checkpoints, and automatic recovery.
anti_bot.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — Isle runs desktop CAD/EDA applications (KiCad, FreeCAD), not a browser product; no anti-bot/stealth feature is documented.

captcha_solving.quote: Managed application environments for computer-use agents. Launch KiCad and FreeCAD with built-in guardrails, artifact checkpoints, and automatic recovery.
captcha_solving.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — no browser or web-facing surface exists to solve CAPTCHAs against; the environment has no external network access.

ssh.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — the entire published surface is screenshot/mouse/keyboard/file/execution APIs; no SSH endpoint or credential is documented anywhere in the SDK or REST reference.

snapshot_auto.quote: Save in the desktop application before checkpointing. ... In-memory edits are not captured.
snapshot_auto.note: Checkpointing is manual/on-demand (sandbox.checkpoint()) or invoked around stop, but state is an application artifact bundle, not an automatic full-machine snapshot; unsaved in-memory edits are explicitly not captured.

fork.quote: `isle.sandboxes.create(environment, *, name=None, retain=True, timeout=360.0, idempotency_key=None) -> Sandbox` Create a new sandbox.
fork.note: No clone/fork endpoint anywhere in the SDK or REST reference; sandboxes are only created fresh from a fixed environment type, stopped, and resumed.

fork_running.quote: `isle.sandboxes.create(environment, *, name=None, retain=True, timeout=360.0, idempotency_key=None) -> Sandbox` Create a new sandbox.
fork_running.note: No fork capability at all (see fork), so cloning a running machine is not possible.

memory_snapshot_fork.note: No fork feature exists, and even the checkpoint/restore mechanism excludes in-memory process state, so no memory-preserving fork/clone is possible.

wake_on_request.note: Resuming a stopped sandbox requires an explicit SDK/API call (sandbox.resume()); no documented mechanism auto-wakes a stopped sandbox when an inbound request arrives (the product has no inbound network surface at all).

live_resize.quote: Managed application environments for computer-use agents. Launch KiCad and FreeCAD with built-in guardrails, artifact checkpoints, and automatic recovery.
live_resize.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — Isle does not expose or price CPU/RAM sizing at all (native environment-hour meter, no vCPU/RAM knobs), so there is nothing to live-resize.

agent_harnesses.quote: Codex and GPT Astra are supported only as client-side examples/shell bridge (examples/codex/desktop.py, examples/astra/run.py), not as a harness running inside the environment driven via API.
agent_harnesses.note: No coding-agent harness (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, etc.) is preinstalled or offered as a template inside the sandbox; example integrations run client-side outside the environment.

own_agent_api.quote: The bridge requires host-side ISLE_API_KEY, invokes no model API, and returns absolute local paths to PNG observations, text, and result evidence.
own_agent_api.note: Isle exposes primitives (screenshot/mouse/keyboard/file/execution) for the caller's own agent to drive; it does not ship a first-party task/research/browser agent of its own that customers call via API.

lang_node.quote: Install the SDK from PyPI. Requires Python 3.9 or later. The package is `isle-sdk`; the Python import is `isle`.
lang_node.note: Only a Python SDK is published; the persistent execution API and default namespace are Python-only (pyautogui, log(), display()). No Node.js SDK or Node runtime inside the sandbox is documented.

public_ipv4.quote: imports, files and installed CLI commands run inside the restricted worker with the shared workspace and no external network access.
public_ipv4.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — the sandbox is reached only via the Isle REST API (screenshots/streaming), and its worker has no external network access; no public IPv4 concept exists.

inbound_https.quote: `stream_url` (str | None): URL to watch the sandbox's screen live.
inbound_https.note: The only URL surface is a provider-hosted screen-stream viewer URL, not a way to expose arbitrary ports/HTTPS on the machine. No inbound HTTPS-to-port feature is documented.

ingress_rules.quote: Managed application environments for computer-use agents. Launch KiCad and FreeCAD with built-in guardrails, artifact checkpoints, and automatic recovery.
ingress_rules.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — there are no exposed ports/services on the machine to control access to; the product is a desktop-application sandbox reached only via the Isle API.

egress_allowlist.quote: imports, files and installed CLI commands run inside the restricted worker with the shared workspace and no external network access.
egress_allowlist.note: There is no outbound network access at all from the execution worker (a blanket block, not a configurable allow/deny list), so no separate provider-side egress-allowlist feature is offered.

egress_http_rules.quote: imports, files and installed CLI commands run inside the restricted worker with the shared workspace and no external network access.
egress_http_rules.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — with no outbound network access at all, HTTP method/path-level egress rules do not exist.

guest_firewall.quote: Sandboxes have no external network access from the execution worker; terminal/browser/package-manager windows are blocked.
guest_firewall.note: root/shell access is not offered (ssh/root are null/false and terminal windows are explicitly blocked), so there is no way to configure nftables/iptables inside the guest.

static_egress_ip.quote: imports, files and installed CLI commands run inside the restricted worker with the shared workspace and no external network access.
static_egress_ip.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — no outbound network access exists from the sandboxed worker, so there is no outbound IP of any kind to make static.

gpu.quote: Managed application environments for computer-use agents. Launch KiCad and FreeCAD with built-in guardrails, artifact checkpoints, and automatic recovery.
gpu.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — a managed CAD/EDA desktop sandbox with a fixed native environment-hour meter and no GPU pricing/type ever mentioned on pricing or docs pages.

windows.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — filesystem paths and worker behavior described throughout the docs are Linux-style (/home/user/work); no Windows machine option is offered.

macos.quote: Managed application environments for computer-use agents. Launch KiCad and FreeCAD with built-in guardrails, artifact checkpoints, and automatic recovery.
macos.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — only two fixed Linux-hosted application environments (KiCad, FreeCAD) are offered; no macOS machine option is documented.

self_host.quote: Managed application environments for computer-use agents. Launch KiCad and FreeCAD with built-in guardrails, artifact checkpoints, and automatic recovery.
self_host.note: Isle is offered only as a managed, hosted service with monthly/enterprise plans and a REST API at www.tryisle.com; no self-hosting package or on-prem deployment option is documented.

byoc.quote: Custom price ('tailored to your workload'); unlimited environment-hours; unlimited concurrency; custom application environments; dedicated support; SLA and uptime guarantees. Contract terms not published.
byoc.note: Even the Enterprise tier is described as a custom contract on Isle's own infrastructure ('custom application environments'), not deployment into the customer's own cloud account; no BYOC option is documented.

open_source.note: The only public GitHub link from the site (github.com/shhivv/arc-cua) is a linked project/example repo, not the core Isle sandbox product; no OSI license is claimed for the core service.

auto_stop_idle.quote: 5 environment-hours/month 30 minute environment runtime 1 concurrent environment ... 100 environment-hours/month No per-session runtime cap 5 concurrent environments
auto_stop_idle.note: Only a hard per-session runtime cap (Free plan, 30 min) and an explicit sandbox.stop()/resume() API are documented; no idle-detection auto-stop behavior is described for any plan.

arm64.quote: Managed desktop environments for computer-use agents, with guardrails, application monitoring, and artifact checkpoints built in.
arm64.note: not offered: outside the product's scope. Isle offers only two fixed application environments (KiCad, FreeCAD) with no customer-selectable machine/CPU architecture anywhere in the docs, SDK, or pricing pages.

soc2.quote: ENTERPRISE Custom tailored to your workload Unlimited environment-hours Unlimited concurrency Custom application environments Dedicated support SLA and uptime guarantees
soc2.note: No SOC 2 attestation is mentioned anywhere on the site, docs, or the Enterprise tier's feature list (which does list 'SLA and uptime guarantees' but nothing about compliance certifications). No trust/security/compliance page exists (tryisle.com/security, /trust, /compliance all 404).

hipaa.quote: ENTERPRISE Custom tailored to your workload Unlimited environment-hours Unlimited concurrency Custom application environments Dedicated support SLA and uptime guarantees
hipaa.note: No HIPAA/BAA mention anywhere on the site, docs, or Enterprise tier feature list; no security/compliance page exists (404s at /security, /trust, /compliance).

sso.quote: Set your API key: export ISLE_API_KEY=isle_...
sso.note: Authentication throughout the docs and REST reference is a single bearer API key created at tryisle.com/api-keys; no SAML/OIDC or team SSO login is documented anywhere, including on the Enterprise tier's feature list.

eu_data_residency.quote: ENTERPRISE Custom tailored to your workload Unlimited environment-hours Unlimited concurrency Custom application environments Dedicated support SLA and uptime guarantees
eu_data_residency.note: No regions or region selection are mentioned anywhere on the site, docs, or REST reference (card's own features.regions is empty); there is no documented way to choose or pin a region, EU or otherwise.

max_session_h.quote: 100 environment-hours/month No per-session runtime cap 5 concurrent environments KiCad and FreeCAD Priority support
max_session_h.note: Free plan is capped at 30 minutes/session, but the paid Developer plan (and by extension Enterprise) explicitly has 'No per-session runtime cap', so a session can run until stopped or the monthly environment-hour allowance is exhausted.

browser.quote: Isle provides managed sandbox environments running real desktop applications (KiCad and FreeCAD) that AI agents can control via screenshots, mouse, keyboard, and file transfer.
browser.note: Environment types are only 'kicad' and 'freecad' (isle.sandboxes.create(environment) accepts only those two); there is no browser environment or managed browser product. 'use your own backend for browser integrations' confirms no first-party browser is offered.

custom_image.note: Sandbox creation only accepts the two fixed native application environments (KiCad, FreeCAD); there is no way to supply a custom Docker/OCI or other custom image.

mcp_server.quote: An Isle MCP connector is not included.
mcp_server.note: Explicit statement that Isle does not ship an MCP server/connector for controlling its sandboxes.

usage_api.quote: All endpoints use owner authentication and a running environment. Sandbox fields: id, name, environment, status, stream_url, retain, recording_url, recording_truncated, recording_truncation_reason, session_limit_minutes, session_ttl_seconds, recovery_attempts, created_at, started_at, stopped_at, las
usage_api.note: granularity: account-only; cost: no; Isle's REST API provides full sandbox lifecycle and monitoring endpoints (screenshots, input, files, checkpoints, events, recordings, provider-deletion tracking), but no endpoint to query billable usage for a specific sandbox. Billing is account-level only, enforced as environment-hours limits per month (Free: 5 hours, Developer: 100 hours, Enterprise: custom/unlimited). The dashboard and invoice may show account usage, but the documented public API has no usage/cost query method.
